newsitem.title: USA: Pa. 833 MW Beaver Valley 2 nuke restart unknown.
newsitem.headline: Pa. 833 MW Beaver Valley 2 nuke restart unknown.

text.p: Duquesne Light Co has not yet scheduled a startup of the 833 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at the Beaver Valley nuclear power facility after it tripped off line earlier today, the company said Monday.
"We are trying to determine the cause of the shutdown. Currently we do not have an estimate for restart," said a company spokesman.
Duquesne, a subsidiary of DQE Inc, operates the Beaver Valley unit.
In its daily plant status report for Monday, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission said the unit is being kept in hot standby and could return to operation as early as Tuesday.
DQE holds a 13.7 percent stake in Beaver Valley 2, while Ohio Edison owns 41.9 percent and Centerior Energy 44.4 percent.
